</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 102

**Price** 2,100 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Katar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=369)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [katar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=369)_ masterfully crafted from the adamantine-laced fang of a [shuln](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3191) can puncture even the toughest of armors.

**Activate—Piercing Critical** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per round;  **Requirements** Your last action was to score a critical hit with the _shuln fang katar_ against a creature that is wearing armor; **Effect** You deal the same amount of damage as the critical hit to the creature’s armor, bypassing any [Hardness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2183) lower than 10, like adamantine.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include a fang from a [shuln](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3191).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
